A collection of two compositions The Aryabhatiya is generally supposed to be a collection of two compositions : (1) Dasagitika-sutra (Aphorisms in 10 gitika stanzas), which consists of Pada 1, stating the astronomical parameters in 10 stanzas in gitika metre, and (2) Aryastasata (108 stanzas in arya metre) or Aryabhata-tantra (Aryabhata’s tantra), which consists of the second, third and fourth Padgs, containing in all 108 stanzas in कक metre. It is noteworthy that the Dasagitika-sutra and the Aryastasata both begin with an invocatory stanza and end with a concluding stanza in praise of the work and look like two different works. The commentator Bhaskara I (A.D, 629) regards the two
